body:
Just noticed this addition. It's nice, because it's one-of-a-kind among these methods. `res://` isn't mentioned anywhere else in this class, for obvious reasons, so maybe it's worth specifying more explicitly while we're at it?

This could be more consistent to the surrounding descriptions:
```suggestion
				Returns the relative path to the editor settings for this project. This is usually [code]"res://.godot/editor"[/code]. Projects all have a unique subdirectory inside the settings path where project-specific editor settings are saved.
```
